_about: Side-by-side mode: how much a MORDHAU-judged melee hit takes off in Skyrim, so that fights follow Skyrim's progression. A hit takes a FRACTION of the target's full health: (1 / hits_to_kill) x quality x level x offence / defence, kept between fraction_min and fraction_max. quality = MORDHAU's damage for that hit / clean_hit (where it landed, its armour, the weapon), kept between quality_min and quality_max. level = (attacker level + level_soften) / (target level + level_soften), kept between level_min and level_max. offence (player only) = the damage Skyrim itself would give this hit (weapon, skill, perks, smithing) / what is ordinary at the player's level (damage_base + damage_per_level per level). defence = full health / what is ordinary at the target's level (player: health_base + health_per_level; others: npc_health_base + npc_health_per_level), and for the player also Skyrim's armour rating (armour_share of Skyrim's own reduction). offence and defence are kept between build_min and build_max. The ordinary-at-level curves are this mod's own choice, to be tuned by play. MORDHAU's weapon balance is kept: which weapon kind hits harder, where the hit lands and what armour it meets is all in MORDHAU's own damage (quality), passed on in proportion. Skyrim's damage only says how good THIS weapon is for its kind (material, smithing) and how skilled its wielder: it is divided by its kind's weight (Skyrim's iron-tier base damage relative to a sword: dagger 4/7, sword 1, war axe 8/7, mace 9/7, greatsword 15/7, battleaxe and warhammer 17/7) before it is compared with the ordinary damage.
